description: Inside the reefer depot: a meat-locker corridor of frosted steel doors, your breath fogging, a clipboard of temperature logs by each. The catch keeps here, and, the manifests hint, things that were never fish.

window.description: A window set too high in the wall to see the ground through, so it offers the sky and nothing else. On a bad day that is more information than you want.
window.name: the high window

name: Chill Out Logistics
